'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Vincent Rossi DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vincent Rossi]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
